blocks.raw:
<Tip>
Joint location: middle third of span (avoid supports and center if possible). Girder offset: 2× beam width minimum from floor joint. Temp steel: ρ = 0.0018 (Grade 60), max spacing = min(5h, 450 mm). Dowels at beam-column joints: ≥50% of flexural steel, normal to joint for shear transfer.
</Tip>

blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={[ "Construction joint can be placed anywhere in the span — WRONG. Must be within middle third (NSCP 6.4.1).", "Girder offset = 1× beam width — WRONG. Always 2× beam width minimum.", "No reinforcement needed at construction joints — WRONG. Temp/shrinkage steel ρ = 0.0018 required (Grade 60).", "Temp steel spacing = full depth (e.g., 450 mm for all) — WRONG. Spacing = min(5h, 450 mm); for thin slabs (h = 100 mm), max = 500 mm, but 450 mm cap applies.", "Temp steel bars can be placed perpendicular to joint (spanning the joint) — WRONG. Bars must be parallel to joint, normal to shear flow direction.", "Construction joint surface does not need preparation — WRONG. Laitance must be removed and aggregate exposed for bond." ]} />
